alternatives.reason: It proves the normalized contract but does not give a human a browser-visible product journey.
Writes, membership and persistence would expand the slice before the read-only user journey is validated.

architecture_impact: Adds the first user-visible React read surface described by the ContextRail architecture.
Exposes the VS-001 normalized registry contract through a small read-only Go boundary.
Makes source status and readiness reason visible without turning derived context into SSOT.
Keeps fixture-backed local execution separate from provider discovery and cloud runtime.
cost_assumptions: Local execution uses no Cloud Run, Firestore or paid connector.
Frontend dependencies must be pinned and installed locally; no production hosting is included.
unknowns: Final frontend bundler and browser test runner after the local toolchain check.
Whether the product API should serve static frontend assets in this slice or run as separate local processes.
Future authentication and Project membership policy.

human_decision.reason: Human review accepted the read-only Go API and React workspace scope for local development/testing. This does not authorize staging, production, IAM, or cloud deployment.
